# Cadence English

> Cadence Talk is a short (3–6 minute) daily easy English podcast (A2–B1) with Mila and Leo, plus shadowing Shorts and a free web app. Episodes 1–4 were hosted by Lina and Adam.

## Brand facts
- Brand: Cadence (also Cadence English). English-learning content for learners in every country. All content is in English.
- Podcast: Cadence Talk: Easy English Podcast. Short (3–6 minute) daily episodes at A2–B1 level, 4 to 6 useful phrases each, with a quick review at the end.
- Hosts: Mila and Leo (from Episode 5). Episodes 1–4 were hosted by Lina and Adam.
- Shadowing Time: daily shadowing Shorts on YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram and Facebook.
- Free web app: https://cadencelearnenglish.github.io/app/ (listen and read along, shadow and record, speaking practice, daily streak).
- Everything is free.

## Pages
- [Home](https://cadencelearnenglish.github.io/): overview of Cadence Talk, Shadowing Time and the app
- [Free app](https://cadencelearnenglish.github.io/app/): the Cadence web app
- [Questions learners ask](https://cadencelearnenglish.github.io/faq/): answer-first replies, each linked to an episode
- [Episode 1: Never Give Up](https://cadencelearnenglish.github.io/episodes/1/): What to do when a goal feels too big: make it smaller, and keep going.
- [Episode 2: Afraid to Speak English?](https://cadencelearnenglish.github.io/episodes/2/): The fear of speaking, why mistakes help you grow, and simple daily habits that build confidence.
- [Episode 3: First Job Interview in English](https://cadencelearnenglish.github.io/episodes/3/): The questions you will hear most in a job interview, and simple answers you can use.
- [Episode 4: Renting an Apartment in English](https://cadencelearnenglish.github.io/episodes/4/): The English you need to find a place, visit it and talk to a landlord: rent, bills, viewings, the deposit and the lease.
- [How do I answer “Tell me about yourself” in a job interview?](https://cadencelearnenglish.github.io/questions/tell-me-about-yourself/): short answer-first page, taught in Cadence Talk Episode 3
- [What can I say in English when I don’t understand a question?](https://cadencelearnenglish.github.io/questions/dont-understand-a-question/): short answer-first page, taught in Cadence Talk Episode 3
- [How do I ask about renting an apartment in English?](https://cadencelearnenglish.github.io/questions/renting-an-apartment/): short answer-first page, taught in Cadence Talk Episode 4
- [How do I stop being afraid to speak English?](https://cadencelearnenglish.github.io/questions/afraid-to-speak-english/): short answer-first page, taught in Cadence Talk Episode 2
